excavation_context.character_description: An adult female grad stadent working as a paleontologist, braided black hair, African ethnicity. Wears a white tee shirt worn UNDER a khaki safari vest, white shorts and black hiking boots.
excavation_context.stage: Chiseling Mudstone Layers on an Exposed Hillside Ridge

composition_prompt: High-fidelity 3D animated feature film style. dino_bones_paleontologist_6 drives a flat steel chisel into a brittle layer of variegated red mudstone matrix out on a sweeping semi-arid plain hillside outcrop. A clean split in the layered stone beautifully reveals the slender, complete hindlimb elements of a small Dryosaurus skeleton. 1:1 Square aspect ratio.
